outsiders.name: Vashi Nedomansky, ACE
outsiders.text:
In 2004, the Sony Disc Explorer 400 could hold the entire 282-disc Criterion Collection and still have room for 118 more DVDs, CDs, SACDs or VCDs.

22 years later, I pay too many streaming services to tell me the movie I want isn't available.

Also, what the hell is an SACD? https://t.co/6eMW9uhSGp
outsiders.original_en:
In 2004, the Sony Disc Explorer 400 could hold the entire 282-disc Criterion Collection and still have room for 118 more DVDs, CDs, SACDs or VCDs.

22 years later, I pay too many streaming services to tell me the movie I want isn't available.

Also, what the hell is an SACD? https://t.co/6eMW9uhSGp
outsiders.hook: Not AI: a film editor's (ACE) nostalgia post about a 2004 Sony 400-disc DVD changer holding the whole Criterion Collection vs today's streaming gaps - 194.8K views, 4,255 likes, 1,149 bookmarks. Cinephile nostalgia plus a relatable gripe.
outsiders.video_tip: Pair a short clip of a physical-media object with a one-line 'then vs now' caption; film-culture nostalgia travels well beyond the AI niche.
outsiders.draft_en:
Back in 2004, one Sony Disc Explorer 400 swallowed all 282 discs of the Criterion Collection - and still had 118 open slots left over for DVDs, CDs, VCDs or SACDs.

Now, 22 years on, we stack streaming video subscriptions just to learn the film we want isn't on any of them.

Also, be honest: does anyone remember what an SACD even was?

outsiders.name: AshutoshShrivastava
outsiders.text:
Gemini 4 Neon + Magnific MCP + Antigravity is probably one of the craziest combo I've used in a while.

Here's what I was working on over the weekend. I couldn't find a single guide that covered the entire image-to-3D, rigging, animation, and expressions workflow in detail, including all the small things and common mistakes you make when you work for the first time.

So I built one for my own future reference and documented the entire process, including the open-source tools and components used. Sharing it here so you can use it too. Hope it helps!
outsiders.original_en:
Gemini 4 Neon + Magnific MCP + Antigravity is probably one of the craziest combo I've used in a while.

Here's what I was working on over the weekend. I couldn't find a single guide that covered the entire image-to-3D, rigging, animation, and expressions workflow in detail, including all the small things and common mistakes you make when you work for the first time.

So I built one for my own future reference and documented the entire process, including the open-source tools and components used. Sharing it here so you can use it too. Hope it helps!
outsiders.hook: Workflow guide: Gemini 4 Neon + Magnific MCP + Antigravity for image-to-3D, rigging, animation and expressions, documented with common mistakes - 6.0K views, 98 bookmarks (1.6% save rate).
outsiders.video_tip: Document your own character pipeline (model sheet - 3D - animation) as a 30s breakdown reel; full write-up in the thread.

x_keywords.method: Read-only x MCP search_posts_all, 2 calls per keyword: last 24 h and previous 24 h (24-48 h ago); lang:en, no retweets/replies, sort=relevancy, up to 25 posts per window. This is a SAMPLE of top-relevance posts, not every post on X. Views = impression_count at fetch time. Rank = sum of sampled 24 h views; 48 h = both windows; trend = 24 h sum / previous 24 h sum (up >=1.3, down <=0.7). Fresh posts are still gaining views, so 'up' is understated. Top-post share > 70% means one viral post carries the keyword.

trend_radar.legend: Trend match 0-100% = 1 - prod(1 - w) over matched 24 h keywords that another author also used in the 48 h window (w: rank 1-10 0.35, 11-25 0.22, 26-40 0.12, curated 0.20). Verdict: >= 50% -> trend; else video/image in the post data -> visual; else >= 100K followers (outsiders without follower data: >= 500K views, estimate) -> author/audience; else coincidence/other. Missing data shows as 'no data'. Heat = sum log10(views) of topic posts (24 h x1, 24-48 h x0.5), scaled to 100. Momentum = log-views last 24 h / previous 24 h. Trend-input-only accounts feed the corpus but are never shown as hits.
